# R5 D14: exact maximal-basis reduction of the remaining dominance frontier

**Date:** 2026-11-20 Asia/Shanghai. **Status:** AUTHOR_EXACT_FINITE_CHECKED / NOT_REVIEWED. Independent *scalar* frozen-R5 research; no native X6/BRC promotion and no formal CLAIM/RUN is asserted.

## Exact scope and prior pin

Frozen scientific pin: `awdawmip/enterprise-math@435e77af0d180eac32bd1f9c4c464bc4010b7551`. Frozen integer input `EXACT_R5_ALL_101_BUDGETS.json` SHA256 `50e87f0194cfb3780e84b7bbb6f9a2dca4f79bb4901cab06f1a5b59256fb470b`. There are 256 names, 101 queries of physical costs 214..314, and observation half-width encoded by `tau=58182461585441404127941754879`. The fixed 12-name core is `W=(0,16,32,48,1,64,17,80,18,24,34,82)`, and each fourteen-name instance augments W by two distinct names. The error budget is eight unflagged arbitrary responses.

The immediate predecessor is `awdawmip/enterprise-math@6c23d330d900a6bf29451832fb0e05e4ad777a2f`, plus its self-contained user-visible exact-evidence bundle `EnterpriseMath_R5_D14_SixRoots_26388_20261120.zip`. The preceding exact Bellman roots and a **cost-aware joint-support** simulation preorder certified 1,265 of 1,906 observer-signature classes (26,388 of 29,646 named pairs) as `V_8=8335`. Its full directed preorder matrix is `dominance_edges_1906.bin`, SHA256 `c5c7c38b678aa5e3830e05895fc59f781bf72f926e5b3c19ea9aeeb262776fa6`, with 38,127 true directed entries; `classes_1906.tsv` SHA256 `0d39bca7ea3d9b6a644fc1a7a4571ef8a688944fc515df5850d0d2d5a78dfdaf`. These data are source-derived from frozen integer observations, not from relaxed numeric intervals.

## New theorem: finite order quotient and minimal dominance-only certificate basis

Let `U` denote the *remaining* 641 uncertified signature classes, representing 3,258 unordered named pairs. Write `i <=_D j` precisely when the existing cost-aware support-preorder matrix has `A[i,j]=1`: for every priced action of j there is a no-more-expensive action of i whose maximal joint observation supports are covered maskwise (possibly swapping the two added names). Thus the Bellman minimax value is monotone, `V_f(i)<=V_f(j)` for every nonnegative integer error budget f in this frozen model. The support-respecting monotonicity is the predecessor's theorem; this note computes an additional exact order-theoretic consequence.

**Finite computation, verified:** the induced `U x U` relation contains exactly **2,384** directed entries including all 641 identities, and is transitive. Its equivalence relation `i~j iff i<=_D j and j<=_D i` partitions U into exactly **468** equivalence components, with sizes **307 singles, 154 doubles, 6 triples, and 1 component of size eight**.

After quotienting by this equivalence, the resulting finite partial order has exactly **278 maximal** components and **133 minimal** components. Of the 278 maximal components, **166** have seven priced actions, **3** have eight, and **109** have nine. Selecting one representative from each maximal component gives a set M of 278 roots, and the exact matrix check establishes

```
forall i in U: exists j in M: A[i,j] = 1.
forall distinct j,k in M: A[j,k] = 0.
```

Consequently, **if** an exact root computation proves `V_8(j)=8335` for each of these 278 representatives, the existing preorder certifies `V_8(i)=8335` for every unresolved class i. The opposite bound `V_8(i)>=V_8(W)=8335` comes from adding hypotheses.

Within **this fixed rule of deriving equality only from individually solved roots plus the existing static preorder**, 278 is the *minimum number of additional root certificates*: any maximal equivalence component requires at least one solved representative of its own, because no other unresolved class lies above it, and none was covered by the predecessor's existing solved-root set. This is **not** a universal lower bound on the number of Bellman solves under stronger arguments (e.g., direct shared policies or a stronger observer simulation).

All numbers and the full 278 representative identifiers can be recomputed with `VERIFY_R5_D14_POSET.py` and are included in `RESULT.json`. Exact ties in the preorder preserve the *frozen scalar optimal-value invariant*, not automatically provenance, native signed-Port or future X6 observations.

## Scientific significance and open work

This replaces an undifferentiated 641-class frontier with a proved 278-component **complete dominance-only certificate basis**. The 173 eliminated nontrivial duplicate class counts are genuine two-way value equivalences in the declared scalar observer model; no original labels, readout signatures or physical support data are discarded from the input. Of the 278 targets, 109 require nine priced actions and appear computationally harder. Two uncompleted exploratory runs, pairs (23,29) and (19,25), each hit an 8,000,000-state cap in the unoptimized f8 solver and produced no value; they do not affect this theorem.

The actual question remains whether any fourteen-name class has `V_8>8335`; an observed strict witness would improve the known lower bound for the full 256-name game, currently `8335<=C^*_8<=8343`. The next useful mathematical step is a certified compressed Bellman/policy-level simulation for difficult maximal components, with the frozen masks and exact integer costs, instead of repeating the already-certified predecessor roots.

## Verification and provenance

Local exact checks: frozen SHA256, 1,906 signature rows, 29,646 pair multiplicities, 3,632,836-byte binary matrix, 38,127 edges, all six predecessor root-propagation increments, all 641 self-edges and induced transitivity, two-way equivalence classes, 278 maxima, maximal antichain, and full downward coverage. This is a deterministic finite-data theorem and depends on the correctness of the predecessor's cost-aware matrix construction and six accepted author root values; Bellman values for the 278 new basis candidates were **not computed in this round**. Independent mathematical review: `NOT_REVIEWED`.
